description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminPanel web page in an ASP.NET WebForms application, handling button click events to perform server transfers to other pages.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Partial class for the AdminPanel WebForm page, handling user interface interactions and navigation.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handler for the Home button click event.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Set Exam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Edit Exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by transferring to the Login page.
